api.cmd: docker run --rm -v "$(pwd -W 2>/dev/null || pwd)/api:/app" -v "$(pwd -W 2>/dev/null || pwd)/shared:/shared" -w /app denoland/deno:2.9.8 sh -c "deno check main.ts && deno lint && deno test --allow-net --allow-env --allow-read --allow-write"

parser.cmd: go vet ./... && go build ./... && go test ./...

services.name: parser
services.cmd: docker network create ship-{job} >/dev/null 2>&1; docker build -q -t ship-parser-{job} doc-parser && docker run --rm --name ship-parser-{job} --network ship-{job} -p {port:parser}:8080 -e PORT=8080 -e GIN_MODE=debug -e OCR_LANGUAGES=eng+ind -v ship-tmp-{job}:/tmp ship-parser-{job}
services.stop: docker rm -f ship-parser-{job}; docker network rm ship-{job} >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

services.name: qdrant
services.cmd: docker network create ship-{job} >/dev/null 2>&1; docker run --rm --name ship-qdrant-{job} --network ship-{job} -p {port:qdrant}:6333 qdrant/qdrant:v1.20.0
services.stop: docker rm -f ship-qdrant-{job}; docker network rm ship-{job} >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

services.name: api
services.cmd: docker network create ship-{job} >/dev/null 2>&1; docker run --rm --name ship-api-{job} --network ship-{job} --add-host=host.docker.internal:host-gateway -p {port:api}:8000 --env-file dev/.env -e PORT=8000 -e QDRANT_URL=http://ship-qdrant-{job}:6333 -e DOC_PARSER_URL=http://ship-parser-{job}:8080 -e CORS_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173 -v "$(pwd -W 2>/dev/null || pwd)/api:/app" -v "$(pwd -W 2>/dev/null || pwd)/shared:/shared" -v ship-tmp-{job}:/tmp -w /app denoland/deno:2.9.8 deno run --allow-net --allow-env --allow-read --allow-write main.ts
services.stop: docker rm -f ship-api-{job}; docker volume rm -f ship-tmp-{job} >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; docker network rm ship-{job} >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

schema.live: supabase MCP in read-only mode, scoped to this project

rules: Never recreate a Qdrant collection. Search with useProjectCollection: true.
No embedding fallback. Never log document text.
Svelte 5 runes and DaisyUI tokens only; no inline handlers (CSP).
Any change to auth, RLS policies or API access checks: run ./scripts/verify-security.sh with the dev stack up and put its result in the PR.
New migrations need the Spec to say so; they are applied by the user, never by an agent.

requires.name: docker
requires.fix: start Docker Desktop (needed for api/parser tickets and their checks)
